canonical_statement: On a finite-dimensional symplectic manifold, every Hamiltonian flow preserves the Liouville volume form, wherever the flow is defined.
domain_and_universes: A finite-dimensional smooth symplectic manifold (M, omega), a smooth Hamiltonian H, its local flow Phi, and the top-degree form omega^n/n!; exact Lean universes and typeclasses remain to be selected.

Phi is the local flow of X_H
conclusion: Phi_t pulls back omega^n/n! to omega^n/n!; equivalently the induced Liouville measure is invariant on measurable sets where the flow map is defined.
